**About Tortus** 

 Tortus is building the next generation of search infrastructure. Standard RAG stacks treat knowledge as flat vector chunks—which fails the moment an answer requires connecting the dots across multiple documents. Bounded agentic loops attempt to solve this, but introduce high latency, cost, and reliability concerns.
 



  





 Tortus offers a middle ground: topology\-aware graph retrieval. We embed typed semantic graphs onto a soft toroidal manifold, allowing developers to query concepts, traverse semantic connections, cross\-domain portals, and return evidence paths, not just text citations. We are an open\-source first, engineering\-driven team building high\-performance retrieval infrastructure.

 Run and expand our automated evaluation suites, comparing Tortus performance against industry baselines (BM25, vector search, external GraphRAG tools).
